contentText: Rapper-turned-politician Balendra Shah has a crushing lead in his race against former prime minister KP Sharma Oli in the Jhapa-5 constituency in the general election, according to ballot counts released Saturday by the Election Commission. The campaign has shaken Nepal's established political heavyweights, harnessing a wave of support unleashed by the September uprising that toppled the previous elected government.
